title: Dad and Jane Bake
lines: Dad and Jane bake a cake.
The cake sits on a plate.
A cat, Jake, hops up on the gate.
Jake gets a lick of the cake!
Jane yells, "That is not for cats!"
Dad will make a small cake for Jake.
Jake laps up his cake fast.
Dad and Jane take the big cake in.

questions.ask: What does Jake the cat do to the big cake?
questions.listenFor: He takes a lick of it. If they just say "he ate it," ask them to find the line and read what he really did.

questions.ask: How does Dad fix the problem?
questions.listenFor: He makes a small cake just for Jake. Listen for them naming the small cake, not only "he was nice."

questions.ask: What do you think Jake will do next? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any guess is fine if it has a reason from the story, like "go back to the gate, because he wants more cake."
